messages.author: 4fe26caaac11aa72
messages.subject: bootstrapLavaan error
parts:
Dear lavaan-team and colleagues,

I'm using the following code
YHY.boot <- bootstrapLavaan(fit, R = 1000, type = "yuan", FUN = fitMeasures, fit.measures = "cfi")

for a unidimensional model with 15 items, WLSMV-estimator and raw data as input for the cfa-function which generates the fit-model-object.
However, I get the follwing error message:
Error in array(x, c(length(x), 1L), if (!is.null(names(x))) list(names(x),  : 
'data' must be of a vector type, was 'NULL'

Removing empty cases, reducing the sample, using ML estimator, doesn't do the trick.
Any suggestions would be great.

Thanks in advance, kind regards,
Ulrich

messages.author: 4fe26caaac11aa72
messages.subject: Re: bootstrapLavaan error
parts:
I've to correct: It has to do with the WLSMV-estimator.
Am I correct that bootstrapLavaan will simply not work with WLSMV?
Any other approach to take?
